overloads.semanticRole: Fills arrObjectNames with the object names of every sub-object (columns/headers/footers) making up the list box, addressed as an object-name string (via the leading '*' flag).

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box via an object-name string (leading '*' passed).

overloads.semanticRole: Fills arrObjectNames with the object names of every sub-object (columns/headers/footers) making up the list box, addressed as a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box via a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').
